_comment: The five playable races. Names are placeholders (see docs/MASTER_DESIGN.md section 11). 'prices' multiplies the price of some goods on that race's planets. 'illegal_goods' are banned on all of the race's planets, whatever the government.

races.description: Brilliant, frail scientists allied with the Veyari.

races.name: Skarn
races.description: Cunning smugglers who work for whoever pays.

races.name: Gorruk
